import sys

def solve():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    k = int(sys.stdin.readline())
    n = len(s)
    dp = [[''] * (n + 1) for _ in range(k + 1)]
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        for j in range(1, n + 1):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j] + s[j-1]
            for l in range(j):
                candidate = dp[i-1][l] + s[j-1:l-1:-1] + dp[i][j-l]
                if candidate < dp[i][j]:
                    dp[i][j] = candidate
    print(dp[k][n])
